subject: Narrowing the close gap — MAP trigger matrix & mitigation log
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Li <megan.li@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Narrowing the close gap — MAP trigger matrix & mitigation log

Hi Megan —

Thanks again for the candid sync this morning. Per our conversation, I attached a focused MAP fragment and a mitigation matrix that isolates the levers we can pull over the next three weeks to preserve the target 2026-10-01 close while satisfying your procurement constraints. The file includes:

- Milestone table (owners, dates, hard/soft commits)
- Trigger matrix (what to do if a milestone slips by 24/48/72 hrs)
- Containment actions (what Redwood will commit to vs. what requires ACME sign-off)

Ask: please confirm whether the procurement gate (legal terms signoff + PO issuance) can be firmed to the week of 2026-09-27 — if yes, we’ll prioritize two parallel items: (1) push the SOC2 evidence pack to your procurement team this week and (2) provision a short-term pilot environment to validate E2E runtime metrics before the final cutover.

Attachment: acme-map-mitigation-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)

If procurement needs a smaller commitment upfront, we can propose a 2-week runway extension and a milestone-based credit to bridge any risk — putting the credit on the table reduces your operational risk and gives time for legal. Happy to run through the matrix with procurement and ops tomorrow.

Best,
Jonas
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124


From: Megan Li <megan.li@acmeinc.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: ACME Procurement <procurement@acmeinc.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 13:46:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Narrowing the close gap — MAP trigger matrix & mitigation log

Jonas —

Thanks for the doc. A couple of clarifications from procurement and IT:

- Procurement needs an explicit SOC2 evidence deliverable by 2026-09-21 to move the PO forward. Can you confirm the exact artifacts you will provide and when?
- Our legal team is asking for a one-page summary of the change control process if the cutover slips; they want to know rollback and data retention behavior.
- Given pending budget cycles, we cannot guarantee a PO before 2026-09-29. That’s the blocker.

If Redwood can deliver the SOC2 artifacts by 9/21 and provide the change-control summary, procurement will prioritize the PO the week of 9/27 but cannot promise sooner.

—Megan
Sr. Program Manager, Platform Integrations | Acme Inc.
megan.li@acmeinc.com | +1 (212) 555-9887

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Narrowing the close gap — internal options (credit vs runway)

Team —

Quick internal note after reading ACME’s reply (procurement likely PO week of 9/27, SOC2 evidence required by 9/21):

Option A (preferred): Commit to delivering the SOC2 artifact pack by 2026-09-20 EOD and provide the change-control one-pager. Ask legal ops to fast-track the amendment once the PO is received. If ACME signs PO week of 9/27, we can keep the 2026-10-01 cutover.

Option B (contingency): If PO slips beyond 9/29, offer a two-week runway extension with a milestone credit (5% of month 1 revenue) capped at one-month credit. This gives us time to finalize legal and avoid an operational rollback.

Operational asks: 
- Monica: can platform team provision the pilot E2E cluster by 9/18 with masked test data?
- Laura: if we go Option B, do we have authority to approve the customer credit or does this need SDR/manager sign-off?

If Laura confirms credit authority, I’ll approve the contingency and Jonas can present options to ACME. Otherwise escalate to finance and Laura’s manager.

-Rishi
Head of Customer Reliability | Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Li <megan.li@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 11:32:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Narrowing the close gap — MAP trigger matrix & mitigation log

Megan —

Appreciate the clarity. We can commit to the items below:

1) SOC2 evidence pack — we will deliver the artifact bundle (control narratives, test reports, and audit scope) by 2026-09-20 EOD.
2) Change-control one-pager — attached (see acme-trigger-log.pdf) with explicit rollback conditions, data-retention notes, and a stop-gap fallback to our dedicated pilot environment.
3) Pilot provisioning — Monica’s team will target 9/18 for a masked-data pilot (Monica, please confirm).

Given your procurement timeline (PO week of 9/27), Redwood will:
- Hold the 2026-10-01 cutover as our target date conditioned on PO issuance by 9/27.
- If PO is delayed beyond 9/29, we propose Option B: a two-week runway extension and a milestone credit (one-time credit equal to 5% of month-1 invoice), which we can formalize in a short amendment.

Attachment: acme-trigger-log.pdf (one-page)

Next step: can we do a 30-minute procurement/ops alignment tomorrow 09/16 at 10:00 ET to confirm on-the-ground owners and signoff criteria? If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite and include the short amendment language for review.

Thanks —
Jonas
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Megan Li <megan.li@acmeinc.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: ACME Procurement <procurement@acmeinc.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 20:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Narrowing the close gap — MAP trigger matrix & mitigation log

Jonas / team —

Thanks — that path is acceptable to procurement and legal in principle. Two quick items before we lock: 

- Please upload the SOC2 artifact bundle to our secure intake link by 2026-09-20 17:00 ET. We cannot accept emailed PDFs.
- We need the amendment language in a DocuSign-ready format before the procurement sync so our legal team can pre-clear it.

Forwarding procurement’s note below for visibility:

-----Forwarded message-----
From: ACME Procurement <procurement@acmeinc.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 15:47:00 -0400
Subject: Redwood amendment & evidence
To: megan.li@acmeinc.com

Procurement: We will prioritize PO week of 9/27 provided SOC2 artifacts are in by 9/21 and the amendment is DocuSigned. If those two happen, we will not block the 10/01 cutover.


Megan Li
Sr. Program Manager, Platform Integrations | Acme Inc.

P.S. Jonas — please send the calendar invite for 09/16 10:00 ET and include the short amendment draft. We’ll loop in our legal counsel on the call if the draft is ready.
